svg.title: H-LEAF · Leaf exchange surface
svg.desc: A transverse leaf section has upper and lower surface layers, elongated cells near the upper layer and separated rounded cells with air spaces below. A gap in the lower surface is labelled stoma. A leader identifies an internal air space. No exchange explanation is printed.
